svg.title: The isotop palette under colour-vision deficiency, and mix against linear light
svg.desc: Eight palette colours for normal vision and for protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia, then the mix of SYSTEM and SESSION as the code computes it (a lerp of encoded bytes) against the linear-light blend, with relative luminance.
svg.text: closest pairs, ΔE00: normal SESSION–STOPPED 4.5 deuteranopia SYSTEM–UNKNOWN_CORE 1.6, SESSION–STOPPED 3.8 tritanopia ZOMBIE–BLOCKED 4.5
Y goes as s^2.2 until a channel clips at 255
